calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.receipt_id,
    f.line_no,
    f.net_amount,
    f.product_key,
    wo.dispatch_ts_utc,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date_hel
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
  WHERE f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = 900)
),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    fr.sales_line_id,
    fr.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line fr
  WHERE fr.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = 900)
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label,
    COALESCE(ws.net_amount, 0) - COALESCE(wr.refund_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM web_sales ws
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.receipt_id = wr.sales_line_id AND ws.line_no = (SELECT line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sales_line_id = wr.sales_line_id)
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = ws.dispatch_date_hel
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = ws.product_key
  WHERE p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  SUM(net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY fiscal_period

WITH sales_hel AS (
  -- Web sales on dispatch date in Helsinki time
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = 900)
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
),
returns_hel AS (
  -- Web returns on return date in Helsinki time
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    -fr.refund_net AS refund_impact
  FROM fact_return_line fr
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fr.return_date
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fr.product_key
  WHERE fr.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = 900)
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
)
SELECT 
  5 AS fiscal_period,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 5 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 5 THEN refund_impact ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS web_net_sales
FROM (
  SELECT fiscal_period, net_amount, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS refund_impact FROM sales_hel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fiscal_period, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS net_amount, refund_impact FROM returns_hel
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  6 AS fiscal_period,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 6 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 6 THEN refund_impact ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT fiscal_period, net_amount, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS refund_impact FROM sales_hel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fiscal_period, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS net_amount, refund_impact FROM returns_hel
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  7 AS fiscal_period,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 7 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 7 THEN refund_impact ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT fiscal_period, net_amount, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS refund_impact FROM sales_hel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fiscal_period, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS net_amount, refund_impact FROM returns_hel
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  8 AS fiscal_period,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 8 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_period = 8 THEN refund_impact ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT fiscal_period, net_amount, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS refund_impact FROM sales_hel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fiscal_period, NULL::DECIMAL(14,2) AS net_amount, refund_impact FROM returns_hel
) combined

WITH web_store_key AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = 900
),
sales_and_returns AS (
  -- Web sales on dispatch date in Helsinki time
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.net_amount AS amount,
    1 AS type_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON f.receipt_id = wo.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM web_store_key)
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Web returns on return date, subtracted
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    -fr.refund_net AS amount,
    2 AS type_flag
  FROM fact_return_line fr
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fr.return_date
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fr.product_key
  WHERE fr.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM web_store_key)
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS web_net_sales
FROM sales_and_returns
GROUP BY fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(rds.net_sales), 2) AS rpt_web_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = rds.business_date
WHERE rds.store_id = 900
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
